title: Derived isomorphism detection on a binary open cover
statement: Let X be a scheme and U,V opens with U union V = X. A morphism phi:E→F in D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category] is invertible if its exact derived over-site restrictions to U and to V are invertible. All required derived categories exist. Restriction is [lem-sc-derived-open-restriction-adjunction-exact].

source.place: Tag 08DF, proof (local cohomology criterion); sheaf locality Tag 04TN

proof.text: Mathlib DerivedCategory.isIso_iff reduces invertibility to invertibility of every homology map. The exact-functor homology comparison identifies the restrictions of these maps with homology of the restricted derived maps.
Apply the existing sheaf-module isomorphism criterion on the Bool-indexed cover consisting of V and U to each homology map. This proves global invertibility.

theorem derived_restriction_isIso_open_cover (X : Scheme.{u}) (U V : X.Opens)
    (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ W : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over W))]
    {E F : schemeDerivedCategory X} (φ : E ⟶ F)
    (hU : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) U).mapDerivedCategory.map φ))
    (hV : IsIso ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) V).mapDerivedCategory.map φ)) : IsIso φ
